items.label: %manageBooks_openMenuItem%
items.localizeNotes: Scripture editor top menu > Project > Manage books… (opens Manage Books targeting the editor's active project; sits between Sync and Project settings in the Project section). Hidden in Simple mode: book management is a Power-mode task there, and the Simple book-not-available message tells the user to ask their project administrator — leaving the item visible would contradict that advice in the very same tab. Same gate the sibling Basic checks and Comments items use

items.label: %webView_platformScriptureEditor_edit%
items.localizeNotes: Scripture editor top menu > Edit ▸ — opens the Undo/Redo/Cut/Copy/Paste flyout (plus Find in Power), in its own section with no heading between Project and View

items.label: %webView_platformScriptureEditor_undo%
items.localizeNotes: Scripture editor top menu > Edit > Undo

items.label: %webView_platformScriptureEditor_redo%
items.localizeNotes: Scripture editor top menu > Edit > Redo

items.label: %webView_platformScriptureEditor_cut%
items.localizeNotes: Scripture editor top menu > Edit > Cut (the selected text)

items.label: %webView_platformScriptureEditor_copy%
items.localizeNotes: Scripture editor top menu > Edit > Copy (the selected text)

items.label: %webView_platformScriptureEditor_paste%
items.localizeNotes: Scripture editor top menu > Edit > Paste

items.label: %webView_platformScriptureEditor_openFind%
items.localizeNotes: Scripture editor top menu (Power) > Edit > Find. Simple offers Find under Tools and resources instead

items.label: %webView_platformScriptureEditor_switchScriptureView_2%
items.localizeNotes: Scripture editor top menu (Power) > View > Switch scripture view ▸ — opens the Standard view / Preview flyout. Hidden in Simple mode, which shows only Preview

items.label: %webView_platformScriptureEditor_standardView%
items.localizeNotes: Scripture editor top menu (Power) > View > Switch scripture view > Standard view — shows the editable view with visible paragraph markers

items.label: %webView_platformScriptureEditor_preview%
items.localizeNotes: Scripture editor top menu (Power) > View > Switch scripture view > Preview — shows the formatted view of the text, the way it reads when published

items.label: %webView_platformScriptureEditor_zoomIn%
items.localizeNotes: Scripture editor top menu > View > Zoom in. Enlarges the text of whichever pane of this editor tab was used last (the Scripture text pane or the footnotes pane); toolbars are unaffected. In Power mode the tab's own context menu offers the same item too.

items.label: %webView_platformScriptureEditor_zoomOut%
items.localizeNotes: Scripture editor top menu > View > Zoom out. Shrinks the text of whichever pane of this editor tab was used last (the Scripture text pane or the footnotes pane); toolbars are unaffected. In Power mode the tab's own context menu offers the same item too.

items.label: %webView_platformScriptureEditor_resetZoomToDefault_2%
items.localizeNotes: Scripture editor top menu > View > Zoom 100%. Returns whichever pane of this editor tab was used last (the Scripture text pane or the footnotes pane) to the Settings default zoom. In Power mode the tab's own context menu offers the same item too.

items.label: %webView_platformScriptureEditor_showFootnotes%
items.localizeNotes: Scripture editor top menu > View > Show footnotes — toggles the footnotes pane's visibility

items.label: %temp_webView_platformScriptureEditor_changeFootnotePaneLocation%
items.localizeNotes: Scripture editor top menu > View > Change footnote pane location — toggles the footnotes pane between bottom and side-by-side

items.label: %webView_platformScriptureEditor_insertCommentAtSelection%
items.localizeNotes: Scripture editor top menu > Insert > Insert comment

items.label: %webView_platformScriptureEditor_insertFootnoteAtSelection%
items.localizeNotes: Scripture editor top menu > Insert > Insert footnote

items.label: %webView_platformScriptureEditor_insertCrossReferenceAtSelection%
items.localizeNotes: Scripture editor top menu > Insert > Insert cross-reference

items.label: %webView_platformScriptureEditor_insertEndnoteAtSelection_2%
items.localizeNotes: Scripture editor top menu > Insert > Insert end note

items.label: %webView_legacyCommentManager_openComments_2%
items.localizeNotes: Scripture editor top menu (Power) > Tools > Comments (opens the Comment List web view). Simple's Tools and resources section brings the Comments tab forward instead

items.label: %webView_platformScriptureEditor_charactersInventory%
items.localizeNotes: Scripture editor top menu > Tools > Inventory. Hidden in both modes; remove "power" from hiddenInterfaceModes to restore it

items.label: %webView_platformScriptureEditor_repeatedWordsInventory%
items.localizeNotes: Scripture editor top menu > Tools > Inventory. Hidden in both modes; remove "power" from hiddenInterfaceModes to restore it

items.label: %webView_platformScriptureEditor_markersInventory%
items.localizeNotes: Scripture editor top menu > Tools > Inventory. Hidden in both modes; remove "power" from hiddenInterfaceModes to restore it

items.label: %webView_platformScriptureEditor_punctuationInventory%
items.localizeNotes: Scripture editor top menu > Tools > Inventory. Hidden in both modes; remove "power" from hiddenInterfaceModes to restore it

items.label: %markersChecklist_menu_openTool%
items.localizeNotes: Scripture editor top menu > Tools > Markers Checklist... (opens the markers checklist for the editor's active project). Hidden in both modes; remove "power" from hiddenInterfaceModes to restore it

items.label: %webView_platformScriptureEditor_openChecks_2%
items.localizeNotes: Scripture editor top menu (Power) > Tools > Basic checks — opens the Checks panel for the editor's project as a tab in the third column, or brings that tab to the front

items.label: %webView_platformScriptureEditor_showBibleTextsPanel%
items.localizeNotes: Scripture editor top menu (Simple) > Tools and resources > Bible texts — brings the Bible texts tab in the third column to the front

items.label: %webView_platformScriptureEditor_showCommentariesPanel%
items.localizeNotes: Scripture editor top menu (Simple) > Tools and resources > Commentaries — brings the Commentaries tab in the third column to the front

items.label: %webView_platformScriptureEditor_showTextCollectionPanel%
items.localizeNotes: Scripture editor top menu (Simple) > Tools and resources > Text collection — brings the Text collection tab in the third column to the front

items.label: %webView_platformScriptureEditor_openFind%
items.localizeNotes: Scripture editor top menu (Simple) > Tools and resources > Find — brings the Find tab in the third column to the front. Power offers Find under Edit instead

items.label: %webView_legacyCommentManager_openComments_2%
items.localizeNotes: Scripture editor top menu (Simple) > Tools and resources > Comments — brings the project's Comments tab in the third column to the front. Orders after 5 stay free for items other extensions add below the built-in tools
